subject: The 3-minute mistake 90% of users make with this app
preview_text: I discovered why some people get 10x more value from Smart Notes while others barely use it. It's not about features.
body_paragraphs: I was reviewing user data last week and noticed something strange. Two people could attend the same number of meetings, use the same features, but one would save 5 hours weekly while the other barely opened the app. The difference wasn't intelligence or dedication. It was a tiny 3-minute routine.

The secret isn't using more features. It's using one feature consistently. The professionals who get insane value from Smart Notes don't just record meetings. They do one thing immediately after every call. They spend exactly 3 minutes reviewing the AI summary while the conversation is still fresh in their mind. That's when they add their own insights, highlight what matters to THEM, and tag the note properly. This tiny habit creates a searchable knowledge base that actually works when you need it.

That's why we built the 'Post-Meeting Review' reminder. It pops up 2 minutes after your meeting ends. Most people dismiss it. The top 10% of users tap it every single time. Those 180 seconds transform Smart Notes from a recording device into your second brain. The AI gives you the skeleton, but your 3-minute review adds the muscle memory.

Open Smart Notes right now and turn on the Post-Meeting Review reminder. Do it before your next meeting. I'll even make it easy - the setting is right on the home screen. This one toggle is the difference between having notes and actually remembering what matters. P.S. The users who do this for 7 days straight report feeling like they've gained a superpower. Not exaggerating.
